items.title: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026
items.description: Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Agave, Firedancer, and Solana Kit shipped updates.

items.title: Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic
items.description: Solana will reduce its slot times from 400ms to 200ms. This change will make the protocol more competitive in terms of latency. Here we explore some possible implication on validators economic.

items.title: Transaction v1 and the ALT Trade-off
items.description: Solana is introducing a new transaction format (v1) alongside an increase of the maximum transaction size from 1232 bytes to 4096 bytes. The v1 format aims to unlock new possibilities on-chain. This is done trading-off Account Lookup Tables (ALT) usage. In this research we explore in details the current usage of ALTs, alongside implications of removing them.

items.title: Solana Changelog: August 13, 2026
items.description: Slot times to 250ms on testnet and releases from Agave and Firedancer.

items.title: How Meow Built Agentic Banking and Agent Payment Rails, with Brandon Arvanaghi
items.description: Meow lets AI agents form a company and apply for a business bank account in one prompt, with payment rails spanning ACH, USDC, SOL, and more.

items.title: Why Asia Is Ahead on Stablecoins, According to Reap's Daren Guo
items.description: Reap moves roughly $6B a year in stablecoin card volume after building cross-border payments infrastructure from Asia.

items.title: MoneyGram Ramps launches on Solana
items.description: MoneyGram Ramps gives Solana builders one API for cash deposits in 25+ countries and withdrawals in 170+ countries and territories.
